title: stand-test agent test plan
description: The machine-checkable output contract of the stand-test-scenario-design skill. It gives the design stage something a free-form markdown document cannot offer: duplicate step ids, steps with no source and an unresolved track are catchable before generation, instead of travelling downstream and surfacing as generated code. PromptOutputSchemaResolutionTest keeps the skill's outputSchema reference pointing here.

runId.description: The run this plan belongs to (the value of AgentRunId).

environment.description: The resolved environment id. A logical name, never a URL — the registry resolves it.

steps.description: The ordered steps. At least one: a plan with no steps is not a plan. NOTE: JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness BY A PROPERTY — `uniqueItems` compares whole elements, so two steps sharing a stepId but differing elsewhere would pass. Duplicate stepIds are therefore rejected by the TestPlan constructor, not here; AgentResponseSchemaTest pins both halves of that split so the gap stays known rather than assumed closed.

openQuestions.description: Blocking questions that must reach a human. Empty when the plan is complete.

identifier.description: Starts with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.

duration.description: Bounded, positive timeout: <n>ms | <n>s | <n>m, with per-unit upper bounds (<=99999ms, <=999s, <=60m) so every schema-valid value stays inside the 1-hour bound PlannedStep enforces. Same grammar as the scenario schema, deliberately: a plan that cannot be expressed as a scenario is not plannable.

plannedStep.description: One planned step. A closed vocabulary.

stepType.description: The step's type. Free-form on purpose: the plan is track-agnostic, and the executable vocabulary belongs to the artifact's own schema.

aliasRef.description: The logical alias the step addresses. Never a URL, host, port or JDBC string.

kbEntryId.description: The knowledge-base entry authorising this step. Either this or assumptionId must be present: an unsourced contract detail is not plannable.

assumptionId.description: The recorded assumption authorising this step, when no knowledge-base entry does.

allOf.description: An awaiting step must say how long it waits. Without a bound it is either a hang or a hidden Thread.sleep — ForbiddenOperation.UNBOUNDED_TIMEOUT.
